sources.entry: Strata Files - Fast, keyboard-first file manager and Finder alternative with instant search, live folder sizes, a disk usage map and dual pane.

summary.one_liner: Strata Files is a native macOS file manager and Finder alternative with fast indexed search, live folder sizes, a disk usage map, and dual-pane browsing.
summary.what_it_does: Strata indexes your home folder and Applications so search results appear as you type, and it accepts plain-English queries and filters such as regex: and kind:book. It shows folder sizes when you open a folder and offers a Disk Usage map view plus Large Files and Duplicates sidebar tools. It supports Icons, List, Columns, Gallery and Disk Usage views, a Dual Pane mode with copy, move, compare and sync between panes, and a ⌘K command palette. The README also describes a copy queue with pause and resume, undoable history, batch rename, archive compress and extract, Git status beside files, and connections to SFTP, S3, SMB/AFP/NFS/WebDAV shares, and Docker-compatible containers. Settings include 17 color themes and Apple Intelligence-based summaries and bulk-change planning.
use_cases: find files quickly by name or content on a Mac
see what is taking up disk space
browse and copy files between two folders side by side
manage files on SFTP, S3 or network shares from Finder-style window
browse and copy files out of Docker or Podman containers
undo accidental file moves or deletions
notable: Search index and history are encrypted on disk with a key stored in the keychain, and AI features run locally
Dual pane with compare and two-way, one-way or mirror sync, verified and undoable
Undo of renames, moves, copies and deletions survives restarts
Browse and manage Docker Desktop, OrbStack, Colima, Podman and Rancher Desktop containers from the sidebar
Color themes added via JSON files without Swift changes
caveats: Requires an Apple silicon Mac running macOS 26
Full Disk Access is recommended for complete search and measurement
Summaries depend on Apple Intelligence for the AI portion; without it only key sentences are shown
keywords: see what is eating my disk
